segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קסו
כְּשֶׁהָעוֹלָם אֵצֶל הַצַּדִּיק יֵשׁ לוֹ מֶמְשָׁלָה:
segments.en: Through hisbodidus — in which one judges and sentences oneself as to whether one is conducting oneself properly — and one corrects one's deeds to conduct oneself according to the laws and ordinances of the Torah — the judgments are sweetened. And through this one merits to joy — until one dances from great joy.
